[Director 指令] [Full Draft] 写一篇 EMNLP 2026 Main 论文，ARR DDL 2026-05-25（13 天）。

## Core Narrative
Task reformulation: 把 execution simulation 从 generation（预测执行输出）转为 classification（预测 pass/fail）。核心发现是 complexity-dependent advantage——函数级两者等价，但 8B scaling 和 repo-level 复杂度下 classification 显著优于 generation。

## Core Claims
1. **Complexity-Dependent Reformulation Advantage**: 函数级 4B CLS vs CWM 等价（F1 diff ~0.9pp, 5-seed），8B gap 扩大到 2.26pp mean (3-seed)。Repo-level 实验进行中（留占位符）。
2. **Diagnostic Granularity At Equivalent Accuracy**: Per-test classification 与 trajectory-level scoring 等价（TOST p=0.007, ±2pp margin），但额外提供 per-test 诊断信息。
3. **Accuracy-Utility Frontier**: Oracle 分析显示 per-test advantage 集中在多 F2P test 实例（T≥2 占 31%），P2P regression rate ~1% 意味着 P2P 信号有限。

## 实验数据完成度
- ✅ 4B CLS vs CWM 5-seed（函数级）
- ✅ 8B CLS vs CWM 3-seed scaling
- ✅ Zero-shot LLM-judge baselines (8B/32B)
- ✅ Trajectory-level finetuned baseline
- ✅ TOST equivalence + clustered bootstrap
- ✅ Oracle F2P stratified analysis
- ✅ P2P regression rate
- ⏳ Repo-level CLS vs CWM（训练中，~15h）→ 章节留占位符
- ⏳ Per-test precision/recall（刚启动，1h）
- ⏳ Block-corr-empirical（刚启动，1h）
- ⏳ Diagnostic re-repair（未开始）
- ⏳ Per-test majority voting（刚启动，3h）

## 写作要求
1. 先产出 `writing_plan.yaml` 提交审批，再动笔
2. 可以立即写的章节：Abstract（草稿版）、Intro、Related Work、Method（formulation + oracle framework）、Experiments 中函数级 + 8B scaling + oracle 部分
3. Repo-level results 用占位符 `[PLACEHOLDER: repo-level results]`，等数据到位后 Patch
4. 引用需要验证——涉及 CWM/Self-Execution/SWE-RM/SWE-bench 等核心 related work
5. 详细 framing 见 `paper_framing.md`，实验数据从 registry 和实验 artifacts 获取

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

IID_COLOR = '#56B4E9'
BLOCK_COLOR = '#0072B2'
ANNOT_COLOR = '#D55E00'

bins = ['T=1', 'T=2', 'T=3–5', r'T$\geq$6']
instance_pct = [68.7, 19.1, 7.1, 5.1]
iid_adv = [-0.04, 18.49, 25.0, 30.0]
block_adv = [-0.09, 31.69, 40.74, 40.06]

x = np.arange(len(bins))
width = 0.35

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))

bars_iid = ax.bar(x - width/2, iid_adv, width, label='i.i.d. model',
                   color=IID_COLOR, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
bars_block = ax.bar(x + width/2, block_adv, width, label='Block-corr model (ICC=0.19)',
                     color=BLOCK_COLOR, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax.axhline(y=0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)

for i, pct in enumerate(instance_pct):
    max_val = max(iid_adv[i], block_adv[i])
    y_pos = max(max_val + 2.5, 3)
    ax.text(x[i], y_pos, f'{pct}%', ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=9, color='#666666', fontstyle='italic')

ax.annotate('55.3% of\ntotal adv.',
            xy=(x[1] + width/2, block_adv[1]),
            xytext=(x[1] + width/2 + 0.6, block_adv[1] + 5),
            fontsize=9, color=ANNOT_COLOR, fontweight='bold',

ax.set_xlabel('FAIL_TO_PASS Test Count (T)')
ax.set_ylabel('Oracle Per-Test Advantage (pp)')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(bins)
ax.set_ylim(-5, 50)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

ax.text(0.98, 0.02, 'Overall: 10.93pp  |  P2P reg.: 1.0%',
        transform=ax.transAxes, ha='right', va='bottom',
        fontsize=8.5, color='#888888')

plt.tight_layout()

out_base = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_16/projects/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/figures/paper/fig3_oracle_stratified'
fig.savefig(f'{out_base}.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_base}.png')
